form.label: Vault Secret Hygiene: Stale & Unrotated Secrets
form.description: Last-accessed age per KV v2 secret, folded from Vault audit logs. Metadata only; audit logs carry HMAC'd values, so no secret value can be rendered here.

html.div: Metadata only. The Vault audit device HMACs every secret value before writing it, so no panel here can render a secret: there is no secret value in the input. Community-built asset, not a HashiCorp product feature.

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_type=kv request.operation=read request.path="*/data/*" | eval secret = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") . 'request.path' | stats max(_time) AS last_read BY secret | inputlookup append=t vault_secret_inventory.csv | stats max(last_read) AS last_read BY secret | where isnull(last_read) | stats count AS never_read

single.option: no read event in the whole audit window

panel.title: Not read in over a year

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_type=kv request.operation=read request.path="*/data/*" | eval secret = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") . 'request.path' | stats max(_time) AS last_read BY secret | where (now() - last_read) > 365*86400 | stats count AS dormant

index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_type=kv request.path="*/data/*" | eval secret = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") . 'request.path' | stats max(eval(if('request.operation'=="read", _time, null()))) AS last_read, count(eval('request.operation'=="update")) AS writes BY secret | where isnull(last_read) AND writes > 0 | stats count AS wasted

single.option: a rotation job is maintaining credentials nothing consumes

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_type=kv request.operation=read request.path="*/data/*" | eval secret = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") . 'request.path' | stats max(_time) AS last_read BY secret | inputlookup append=t vault_secret_inventory.csv | search secret="$ns$*" | stats max(last_read) AS last_read BY secret | eval age_days = if(isnull(last_read), -1, floor((now() - last_read) / 86400)) | eval bucket = case(age_days < 0, "7 never read", age_days <= 30, "1 under 30d", age_days <= 90, "2 31-90d", age_days <= 180, "3 91-180d", age_days <= 365, "4 181-365d", age_days <= 540, "5 366-540d", true(), "6 over 540d") | stats count AS secrets BY bucket | sort bucket

panel.title: Cleanup candidates (worst first). Paths only; no secret values exist in audit logs.

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_type=kv request.path="*/data/*" | eval secret = coalesce('request.namespace.path',"") . 'request.path' | stats max(eval(if('request.operation'=="read", _time, null()))) AS last_read, max(eval(if('request.operation'=="update", _time, null()))) AS last_write, count(eval('request.operation'=="read")) AS reads, count(eval('request.operation'=="update")) AS writes BY secret | inputlookup append=t vault_secret_inventory.csv | search secret="$ns$*" | stats max(last_read) AS last_read, max(last_write) AS last_write, sum(reads) AS reads, sum(writes) AS writes, values(namespace) AS namespace BY secret | eval reads = coalesce(reads,0), writes = coalesce(writes,0) | eval last_read_age = if(isnull(last_read), "never", floor((now()-last_read)/86400)), last_rotated = if(isnull(last_write), "never", strftime(last_write,"%Y-%m-%d")) | where isnull(last_read) OR (now() - last_read) > 180*86400 | eval verdict = case(isnull(last_read) AND writes > 0, "ROTATED BUT NEVER READ - pure waste", isnull(last_read), "never accessed", true(), "dormant over 180 days") | table secret namespace last_read_age last_rotated reads writes verdict | sort - writes

format.colorPalette: {"ROTATED BUT NEVER READ - pure waste":#DC4E41,"never accessed":#F8BE34}

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_class=auth request.operation=update | where match('request.path', "/login$") | timechart span=7d count BY request.mount_type

panel.title: Auth mounts still taking traffic (is anything here decommissioned?)

search.query: index=vault_audit sourcetype="vault:audit" type=response request.mount_class=auth | eval method = 'request.mount_type' | stats count AS events, max(_time) AS last_seen, dc(auth.display_name) AS distinct_clients BY method | eval last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d") | sort - events
